in_sanskrit.name: Binesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Binesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Binesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bin' meaning wealth and 'Ish' meaning Lord. This name is associated with the god Ganesha, who is known as the lord of wealth and prosperity in Hindu mythology.
